# Environment maps

`studio-environment.png`: copied unmodified from the RocketWright asset pack
(maintainer-held source files, not published separately). 2048×1024 neutral
equirectangular **LDR** studio panorama (not calibrated HDR lighting data),
original RocketWright artwork, generated for this project with Codex's
built-in image-generation tool (1774×887, resampled without cropping to
2048×1024); no third-party image or stock source. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later,
the project license (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE.md`).

sha256 `ce711a3e545d1d8e56a51253ab6f1d3a0f6fffa4f78a28aae8e6f0c3fe3a6523`.

Used as `scene.environment` (reflections and image-based light) by the RL1
visual spikes (`spikes/`) and, from M3.1, the viewport studio lighting.
